note: The two audience paths, used by the side-by-side benefits split and the tabbed process section on Home. `steps` are a real sequence, which is why they carry numbers; `benefits` are not a sequence and must never be numbered.

list.label: For job seekers
list.headline: Someone whose job is getting you hired.
list.lead: Not a job board with a login. A recruiter who reads your resume, knows which employers are actually hiring, and stays with you through the offer.

image.alt: A candidate in conversation with a recruiter

benefits.title: Matched, not blasted
benefits.text: Your profile goes to employers who are hiring for it — never sprayed across a hundred listings.

benefits.title: Interview coaching
benefits.text: Prep before every conversation that matters, on the questions that role will actually ask.

benefits.title: Offer and negotiation help
benefits.text: We stay in the room through the offer, and tell you plainly when one isn't worth taking.

benefits.title: Training that leads somewhere
benefits.text: If a skills gap is the blocker, our IT tracks feed straight back into this pipeline.

benefits.title: Free for candidates
benefits.text: You are never invoiced. Employers pay our fee — that is the whole model, stated up front.

steps.label: Apply
steps.description: Tell us where you are and where you want to be. One form, no account to create.

steps.label: Intake call
steps.description: A recruiter reads your resume properly, then calls to fill in what it left out.

steps.label: Match
steps.description: We put you in front of employers hiring for your actual profile, and tell you who and why.

steps.label: Interview
steps.description: Coaching before each round, and honest feedback after the ones that don't land.

steps.label: Placement
steps.description: Negotiation support, then a check-in ninety days in to make sure it stuck.

list.label: For employers
list.headline: A shortlist you can act on this week.
list.lead: Sourced, screened, and reference-checked against the brief you actually wrote — not a keyword-matched version of it.

image.alt: A hiring team reviewing candidates together

benefits.title: Screened before you see them
benefits.text: Every candidate is interviewed by a person against your brief before the resume reaches you.

benefits.title: Contract, temp, or permanent
benefits.text: One team across all three, so a role can change shape without restarting the search.

benefits.title: Verification built in
benefits.text: Employment, education, and reference checks handled before an offer becomes a hire.

benefits.title: Specialist search when volume won't work
benefits.text: Senior and hard-to-fill roles move to Talent Acquisition, a different practice with a different method.

benefits.title: Terms stated plainly
benefits.text: Engagement structure is on the page, not held back for a call. You know how we work before you enquire.

steps.label: Brief
steps.description: We take the role properly — the work, the team, the constraints, and what has failed before.

steps.label: Source
steps.description: Active search across our bench and the wider market, not a repost of your listing.

steps.label: Screen
steps.description: Human interviews against your brief. You receive a shortlist with notes, not a resume dump.

steps.label: Interview
steps.description: We coordinate rounds, chase feedback, and keep candidates warm while you decide.

steps.label: Verify and close
steps.description: Background checks, offer management, and a follow-up once they're actually in the seat.
